name: TC-SUT-03: wizard rejects fewer than 2 uploaded photos on Sell Used Trucks
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/SellUsedTrucks.cy.js#UsedTruck - SellUsedTrucks [en] — Sell Used Trucks TC-SUT-03: wizard rejects fewer than 2 uploaded photos on Sell Used Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SUT-03
**Title:** Wizard rejects fewer than 2 uploaded photos on Sell Used Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Complete Steps 1 and 2, then on Step 3 upload only one photo (the site requires a minimum of 2) and click Next.

**Expected Result:**
The real "Please upload atleast 2 images for your listing" validation message is shown, and the wizard stays on Step 3 — the Full Name field (Step 4) never appears.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Sell Used Trucks page
2. Complete Step 1 (brand) and Step 2 (model/year/km/price)
3. Upload only one photo on Step 3 and click Next
4. Verify the minimum-2-images validation message is shown
